question: Who among the following was conferred a Lifetime Achievement Honour in the year 2023 by the India-UK Achievers Honours in London for his contribution to economic and political life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manmohan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Former PM **Manmohan Singh** was conferred the **Lifetime Achievement Honour** in **January 2023** by the India-UK Achievers Honours in **London** for his contribution to economic and political life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• He was conferred the Lifetime Achievement Honour by India-UK Achievers Honours in London for his contribution to economic and political life.
 
• The India-UK Achievers Honours by NISAU UK celebrate the achievements of Indian students who studied at British universities.
 
• The Lifetime Achievement Honour is a nod to Dr Singh’s academic achievements at the Universities of Oxford and Cambridge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
